items.lede: In its prospectus, Anthropic just told investors it's losing tens of billions of dollars a year, but also growing like crazy, and — oh yeah — its own AI might pose an existential risk to humanity.
items.title: Anthropic’s prospectus details losses, growth, and, yes, a warning that its AI could end humanity

items.lede: Despite a $2 trillion valuation ahead of its IPO, Anthropic hasn't been a money-spinning operation so far.
